notes: Do not upgrade public pricing or storefront defaults to real without invoice, settlement export, contract, or enrolled-program proof for the active account.
Keep absent when the current backend expects a unit cost in USD but the available operational evidence is only a monthly fee or a fee denominated in another currency.
Public FX references can support estimated_reliable normalization when they are explicit, dated, and not mislabeled as account-settled FX.

routingCostUsdPerCall.evidence: Modeled marginal backend serving proxy for routing requests. Keep modeled until measured or invoice-backed per-request cost exists for the active routing path.

weatherCostUsdPerCall.evidence: Modeled marginal backend serving proxy for weather requests. Keep modeled until measured or invoice-backed per-request cost exists for the active weather path.

percentFee.evidence: Current BRL product assumption for Stripe billing. Keep estimated_reliable until the active Stripe account exposes invoice-backed settlement exports or contract terms.

fixedFee.evidence: Current BRL product assumption for Stripe billing. Keep estimated_reliable until the active Stripe account exposes invoice-backed settlement exports or contract terms.

stripe.compatibilityNote: Legacy economics scripts still expect paymentProcessorFixedFeeUsd. This template derives that compatibility value from an explicit PTAX reference and keeps it estimated_reliable, not real.

chosenPercentFee.evidence: Conservative default until Small Business Program enrollment or year-two subscription evidence is attached for the active Apple account.

reducedPercentFee.evidence: Only promote this rate when the active Apple account proves Small Business Program enrollment or eligible year-two subscription treatment.

percentFee.evidence: Public Play subscription default for the current billing assumption. Keep estimated_reliable until payout exports or console-backed proof is attached.

backgroundWorkerExecutionCostUsdPerExecu.evidence: Missing measured per-execution worker cost for the active background worker path.

infraCostPerUserUsd.evidence: Missing operator-approved per-user allocation formula for monthly infrastructure.

routingCallsPerPremiumUserMonthly.evidence: Missing measured per-user routing usage export.

weatherCallsPerPremiumUserMonthly.evidence: Missing measured per-user weather usage export.

BRL.evidence: Banco Central do Brasil PTAX venda de 30/04/2026 usado como referencia publica para normalizacao BRL/USD. Keep estimated_reliable because this is not the account's settled FX.

usdToBrl.evidence: Banco Central do Brasil PTAX venda de 30/04/2026 usado como referencia publica para normalizacao BRL/USD. Keep estimated_reliable because this is not the account's settled FX.

blockers: Legacy strict gates still require webServingCostUsd as a per-request unit cost; the corrected v2 file only has a monthly Render web service estimate so far.

Variable unit costs for feed, provider miss, weather miss, routing, map sessions, SOS relay, queue jobs, cache ops, storage, telemetry, and worker execution remain absent until invoice-backed or measured evidence is attached.
operatorChecklist: Refresh the PTAX reference whenever you intentionally update BRL/USD normalization in the operational pricebook.
Attach Render invoices or chosen service-tier screenshots for queue Redis, cache Redis, web service, and background worker when available.
Measure or contract variable unit costs before promoting any currently absent unit-cost field.
Keep absent when the only known evidence is public pricing without proof that it matches the active account, tier, contract, or routed traffic.
